name: Automatic Theme Switcher
description:
Automatically switches between light and dark themes based on sunrise/sunset times for your location.
Supports multiple trigger options (golden hour, dawn, dusk, etc.), gradual brightness transitions, and syncs with Night Light.

Uses ipinfo.io, sunrisesunset.io, and openstreetmap.org services.

If you find any bugs/issues, feel free to create an issue at https://github.com/amritashan/gnome-shell-extension-auto-theme-switcher/issues
